children: 264,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery in Joliet, Illinois, experienced a power outage on Sunday afternoon, the company said on Monday.
The outage occurred at about 3:30 p.m. CT on Sunday and triggered the refinery's safety flare.
The cause of the incident remains under investigation, Exxon Mobil said in a statement.
The Joliet refinery supplies key fuels to consumers in the U.S. Midwest. It can produce about 11 million gallons a day of gasoline and diesel fuel, according to the company website.

The disruption comes amid an usually tight global fuel market. The U.S.-Israeli war involving Iran and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries have strained fuel supplies, while strong exports has further tightened domestic inventories.

The U.S. national average price of diesel last week surpassed $6 a gallon for the first time ever. Any prolonged operational disruptions could exacerbate an already tight fuel market, sending prices even higher.
